Christian does not yet know the exact nature of the trouble, whether it involves illegal activity, that Jonathan is being framed, or who the real culprit is. Those are revealed only in later scenarios.

At this point, Christian’s belief is that Jonathan is in trouble and needs help. His emotional response is worry and empathy. This belief and emotion directly lead him to form the intention to help and support Jonathan, as shown when he says, “Please, let me help you” and “Tell me what you need, and I’ll do everything I can to help.”

This matches option c: Christian’s belief and worry lead him to decide to help Jonathan.
